subject: Re: POC scope re-baseline for AcmeCorp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC recap + next steps (AcmeCorp)

Hi Jordan — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same page: 

- Scope: 2 initial inference use cases (customer support triage + FAQ retrieval) running for a 4‑week POC on our Dedicated environment.
- Success criteria (proposed): 1) average response latency < 300ms for N1 queries, 2) accuracy F1 > 0.82 on your labelled sampling set, 3) cost target < $0.015/1000 tokens for baseline throughput.
- Evaluation plan: we’ll ship a validation harness and a small labelled set; Acme will provide 500 example tickets + expected labels for evaluation.
- Timeline: kickoff next Wednesday (09/22), baseline ingestion + validation by week 1, iteration weeks 2–3, final evaluation week 4.
- Ownership: Marissa (Redwood) PM + technical lead; Jordan (Acme) product owner, Alex (Acme) eng lead.

Action items for this week: 
1) Jordan — share the sample tickets and label schema by Friday 9/18.
2) Marissa — send POC plan + evaluation metrics doc (attached).
3) Rishi — provide pricing guidance and any procurement steps to expect.

I’ve attached the initial POC plan and evaluation metrics doc. If this looks right I’ll update the SOW and send a DocuSign for signatures.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: POC-plan-v1.xlsx (stub), evaluation-metrics.md (stub)

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Wu <alex.wu@acmecorp.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC recap + next steps (AcmeCorp)

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. Two quick asks from our side after the internal sync: 

1) We want to add a short second-phase use case to the POC: "automated initial triage + priority scoring" for inbound tickets. It’s similar to support triage but needs an additional priority classification output (high / medium / low). Would you be able to include that as a scoped add-on (estimate of effort and any impact on timeline/pricing)?

2) On success criteria, can we add a QoQ measure for priority classification (precision > 0.78)?

If adding the triage+priority requires a re-baseline, we’re ok with a slightly extended timeline as long as we have clear owners and a revised SOW. I’ll aim to get the 500 tickets and label schema to you by Friday.

—Jordan
Jordan Lee | Senior Product Manager, AcmeCorp
jordan.lee@acmecorp.com

Jordan — great callout. I’ve sketched an updated POC plan attached (POC-plan-v2.xlsx) and a short addendum in the evaluation doc. Summary of the re-baseline: 

- New scope: add "priority scoring" as a scoped add-on for phase 1. This adds one additional model endpoint and evaluation dimension.
- Updated success criteria: 
  * Latency: average response latency < 350ms for combined endpoints (we’ll optimize separately but budget for slight increase),
  * Support triage accuracy: F1 > 0.82,
  * Priority classification precision > 0.78,
  * Cost: target <$0.02/1000 tokens with the priority add-on enabled.
- Timeline (revised): kickoff 09/22, data ingestion + baseline 09/29, priority model proto 10/06, iteration 10/06–10/13, final eval 10/20. Total ~5 weeks.
- Ownership: Marissa — Redwood PM/PO; Dev — Redwood eng lead for integration; Jordan — Acme product owner; Alex — Acme eng for data pull and test harness.

Action items (owners):
- Jordan / Alex: deliver 500 labeled tickets + priority labels by 09/18 (Jordan) OR 09/21 latest if blocked.
- Dev (Redwood): prepare ingestion pipeline and sample harness by 09/24.
- Marissa: update SOW + PO and circulate for signatures; include change note for pricing impact.
- Rishi: please drop pricing delta + procurement notes (cc’d).

Attachments: POC-plan-v2.xlsx (attached) — includes a breakdown of effort and a pricing delta table; evaluation-metrics.md updated with priority-class metrics.

If that works, I’ll circulate an updated SOW (DocuSign) by EOD tomorrow so you can review with legal and procurement.

Thanks — Marissa
